spell.name: Stellar Omen
entries: You read a brief omen from the stars. Roll a {@damage d4}. You can add or subtract that roll to or from any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} made by a creature within 30 feet of you within the next round.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The distance at which you can affect a creature increases by 30 feet at 5th level (60 feet), 11th level (90 feet), and 17th level (120 feet).

spell.name: Celestial Mark
entries: Mark a creature with a celestial sign. The target is marked by fate and must make an Intelligence saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} radiant damage.
While marked, attack rolls against the target have a {@dice 1d6} bonus. This mark lasts until the target is hit with an attack or until one minute passes.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@damage 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@damage 2d6}), 11 ({@damage 3d6}), and 17 ({@damage 4d6}).

spell.name: Wandering Star
entries: You create a mote of starlight that sheds 20 feet of {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} and 20 feet of {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}; it floats around you or travels to a point you can see within 120 feet. You can change whether it orbits you or follows your mental direction (no action required) as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, and it moves at your Speed. Also as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can dim the star to a minimum of 10 feet of Dim Light.

spell.name: Minor Constellation
entries: You trace a constellation in the air, creating 6 points of light connected by fine luminous lines. For the duration of the spell, you can organise these lines into a symbol, map, or simple diagram. Only very simple background detail can be created around the constellation, but the lights can take on the vague form of an object or creature to help illustrate your point.
The image hovers in place and moves with you, and sheds 5 feet of {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}.

spell.name: Astral Trace
entries: You study an object you can see within 30 feet. You learn whether it has been moved, touched, or magically altered within the last hour, but not by whom. For example, you might see a faint glowing star-trail where a heavy object was dragged, a glowing handprint where the last location it was touched was, or a spectral image of the item's previous form overlayed on top of it.

spell.name: Guiding Star
entries: You designate a visible point or location as your guiding star. For the duration, you always know the direction to that location while you are on the same place of existence. The spell does not reveal the route or distance.

spell.name: Moment of Uncertainty

time.condition: when a creature rolls a D20 Test

entries: You shift a creature momentarily along the Cosmic Gradient, giving it a glimpse of a possible future where it becomes closer to or further from its goal. Choose one of the following:
{@b Blueshift.} The creature makes the {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.
{@b Redshift.} The creature makes the {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

spell.name: Bias Fate
entries: The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed saving throw, fate leans against it: attacks made against it have a {@dice 1d4} bonus to the attack roll; when it forces a creature to make a saving throw, that creature adds {@dice 1d4} to the saving throw; and whenever it makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, it subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the result.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Ward Misfortune
entries: You protect a creature from grave misfortune. Until the start of your next turn, whenever the target makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, it can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Cosmic Shift
entries: You move a creature along the Cosmic Gradient for the duration, accelerating or decelerating it. You grant it one of the following effects for the duration; an unwilling creature can make a Wisdom saving throw to resist, and repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
{@b Blueshift.} When the target takes the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, it can make one additional attack as part of that action.
{@b Redshift.} When the target takes the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, it can make one fewer attack as part of that action (minimum 1 attack).

spell.name: Starlike Skim
entries: You temporarily take on a form of starlight, becoming pale and translucent. Until the start of your next turn, you gain the following benefits:

You gain 15 feet of movement speed. You can pass through other creatures' spaces, move over liquid and non-solid surfaces harmlessly (but not stand on them), and your movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.
As part of casting the spell, you end any effects on you that cause you to be {@condition Grappled|XPHB}.

spell.name: Follow the Stars
entries: You see the celestial patterns of the sky and allow them to guide you in the right direction over long distances.

{@b Choice.} Whenever you encounter a meaningful choice of direction, you can spend a moment observing your surroundings. Choose one of the following traits, the DM reveals which of the routes forward most fits that criteria: safest, fastest, most direct, or the path with the most reward.

{@b Navigation.} While you can see the night sky: you and your immediate allies have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks made on your journey, and moving at a fast pace does not affect your Wisdom ({@skill Perception} or {@skill Survival}) or Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

spell.name: Gradient Exchange

m.text: a pair of silvered handheld mirrors, each worth 100gp

entries: You alter the relative energy of two creatures. Choose two creatures within range, each of whom receives one of these effects:
{@b Redshift.} You take a creature's energy. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 5d8} Necrotic damage on failure, or half as much damage on a successful save.
{@b Blueshift.} You grant a creature the stolen energy. The target regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Necrotic damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|3-9|1d8} for every spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Redshift Veil

m.text: a chunk of pink quartz worth 50gp

entries: You bend the Cosmic Gradient in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} centered on you. Within that {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, creatures appear slightly further away and less distinct. For the duration of the spell, any creatures within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} cannot be identified by their appearance, and ability checks (such as Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB} or {@skill Perception|XPHB} or Intelligence ({@skill History}) checks made to locate and identify them (by traits other than their appearance) have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

spell.name: Starfire
entries: You channel a fraction of a star's light into an unstoppable celestial lance. Choose a creature, it and all other creatures in a 5-foot wide line between you and that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. This effect ignores 1/2 or 3/4 cover.

On a failed save, each creature takes {@damage 3d10} radiant damage and becomes {@condition Burning|Starlight}, the chosen creature taking an additional {@damage 3d10} fire damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and does not start Burning .

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The radiant and fire damage each increase by {@scaledamage 3d10|3-9|1d10} for every spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Starfall
entries: A sphere of radiance falls from above and strikes the target. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 8d6} radiant damage on a failure and half as much on a success. All other creatures within 20 feet of it must also make a Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|4-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Starlight's Shadow

components.m: a pinch of charcoal and chalk

entries: You cover a creature with a cloak of stars and shadows. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action}, the target can raise or lower the hood; you choose if it is raised or lowered when you cast the spell. With the hood lowered, the target has a flying speed of 60 feet and resistance to necrotic damage. With the hood raised, the target is {@condition Invisible|XPHB} and has resistance to radiant damage; if the target makes an attack or forces another creature to make a saving throw, the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition ends until the start of their next turn.

spell.name: Shelter of the Firmament
entries: A sphere of stars and luminous celestial bodies surrounds you, some orbiting you in a ring, in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that moves with you for the duration.
Attacks made by creatures outside of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} against you and allies of your choice within it.

Whenever you or an ally within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} takes damage, you can use your {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} to cause nearby stars to intercept the harm. The damage the creature takes is reduced by {@damage 2d4} plus your spellcasting ability modifier. If the creature that dealt the damage is within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, it takes Radiant damage equal to the damage reduced.

spell.name: Starlight Sending
entries: You place an illusory image of yourself within 10 feet of a willing creature of your choosing. If the creature is not willing, the spell fails. The image appears to be made of stars, with constellation lines joining them, and an ethereal blue mist filling the space inbetween. For the next minute, you can converse and see as if you were there. Your physical self is {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Deafened|XPHB} for the duration.

spell.name: Parallax Shift
entries: Choose up to 8 creatures within range. For each creature, you teleport it to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of its starting position and within the range of the spell. The destination must be a surface that can support it and cannot be immediately harmful (such as over a chasm, or in a fire).

An unwilling creature can make a Charisma saving throw to partially resist the effect: on a successful save, it can choose a location within 5 feet of its target destination to be teleported to instead.

spell.name: Diverge/Converge
entries: When you cast this spell and as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on each of your turns, you can create a blast of force that pulls from the Cosmic Gradient. The blast is a 30-foot {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you can see within range. When you create each blast, choose one of the following:
{@b Blueshift.} Creatures of your choice within the blast must make a Strength saving throw or be pulled 15 feet towards the center of the area.
{@b Redshift.} Creatures of your choice within the blast must make a Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from the center.
With either option, a friendly creature of your choice within the blast can move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@variantrule Opportunity Attacks|XPHB}.
If either effect results in multiple creatures sharing a space, each creatures falls {@condition Prone|XPHB} unless it is two sizes larger than any other in the space.

spell.name: Astral Convocation

m.text: four dice made of stained glass, each worth at least 150gp

entries: You call on a council of astral spirits, gaining their blessings and insights.
You regain your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} at the start of every turn, not just your own.

When a creature within 30 feet of you makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can use your Reaction to allow them to roll an additional d20, you choose which result to use. When you use this reaction, you can cause that creature to regain {@dice 5} hit points.

spell.name: Nebular Genesis
entries: You create a swirling nebula at a point you can see within range. The nebula fills a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} and sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 60-foot radius. The nebula advances through three stages of its lifecycle, described below. You cause the first stage when you cast the spell. As a {@variantrule Magic|XPHB} action on your later turns, you can advance it to its next stage, ending the current one. If you don't advance it yourself, the nebula advances to its final stage when the spell's duration expires. If your {@status Concentration} ends, or the nebula is dispelled, it ends with no effect as normal.

{@b Stage 1: Coalescence.} Matter is drawn to the center of the nebula with gravitational force. Each creature within the sphere makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 5d10} Force damage and is pulled to an unoccupied space of your choice within 5 feet of the sphere's center. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't pulled. Unsecured objects that are not being worn or carried are pulled towards the center.

{@b Stage 2: Providence.} The nebula expands into a cloud of gases and starlight. The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} to creatures of your choice. You and any creatures you choose when this stage begins can see through this obfuscation. In addition, you and the chosen creatures gain the benefit of {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half-Cover} while within the sphere.

{@b Stage 3: Separation.} The nebula collapses in on itself and releases the accumulated energy. Previously chosen creatures within the sphere regain {@damage 5d8} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. All other creatures within 30 feet of the Nebula's center must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 5d10} Force and {@damage 5d10} Radiant damage and is pushed 20 feet away from the center. On a successful save, they take half as much damage only. The spell then ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Radiant damage and the Force damage increase by {@scaledamage 5d10|7-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Celestial Alignment

m.text: a set of ten engraved constellation tiles, worth 500gp

entries: You examine the stars, and attempt to pull their alignment into one that is favourable for you. Roll {@damage 10d10}. The number of dice you get that matches any other dice determines the effect, described below.

{@note For the purpose of this spell, the number of matching dice refers to any die that has the same value as another, and not all matches need to share their value. Rolling 1, 2, 2, 4, 5, 5, 5, 9, 10, 10 would be 7 matches.}

items.name: No Matches
entries: You die.

items.name: Two Matches: Luck Sacrifice
entries: Until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}. The nearest creature to you (if multiple creatures are equally distant, you choose) has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} for the next hour.

items.name: Three Matches: Chaos
entries: Whenever a creature rolls a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} within 60 feet of you, it rolls twice and uses the result furthest from 10.

items.name: Four Matches: Realignment
entries: You and every creature within 60 feet of you immediately gain the benefit of the {@spell Starlike Skim|Starlight} spell and can immediately use the movement granted by the spell.

items.name: Five Matches: Starfall
entries: A creature of your choice that you can see within 90 feet takes radiant damage equal to the total you rolled.

items.name: Six Matches: Protection
entries: A creature of your choice that you can see within 90 feet gains hit points equal to the total rolled, and a creature you can see within 90 feet gains temporary hit points equal to the total rolled.

items.name: Seven Matches: Starlight Blessings
entries: You and any creatures of your choice within 30 feet are blessed: you gain the benefits of the {@spell Bless|XPHB} spell until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

items.name: Eight Matches: Personal Alignment
entries: For the next minute, whenever a creature within 30 feet of you makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can add or subtract one of the dice rolled from the total. Dice that are 6 or higher can be added, and dice that are 5 or lower can be subtracted. Once you have used one of the rolled dice, you cannot use it again.

items.name: Nine Matches: Restoration
entries: All creatures of your choice that you can see regain hit points equal to the total rolled and any conditions of their choice end on them.

items.name: Ten Matches: Will of Fate
entries: You immediately cast the {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell (no action required). You can duplicate a spell of up to 9th level without incurring the stress described in the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Roll an additional {@scaledamage 10d10|7-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Gravitic Flux

m.text: a dense metal sphere worth 1000gp and weighting at least 10lbs

entries: You create a 30-foot radius sphere of violently-shifting gravity centered on a point you can see within range. Teleportation through the edge of the field is impossible. When the spell is cast, and at the start of each of your turns, choose a flux state from the options below. The effect applies to all creatures within the area.

items.name: Collapse
entries: Creatures in the area must make a Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet towards the center and take {@damage 5d10} force damage. On a successful, they take half damage and are not pulled.

items.name: Inversion
entries: Creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw or be pulled 30 feet into the air and {@condition Restrained|XPHB}. At the end of their next turn they are pulled into the ground as if they had fallen that distance and the condition ends.

items.name: Temporal Distortion
entries: Creatures in the area must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they cannot take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions}, and become {@condition Dazed|Starlight}. The effect lasts until you create a different flux state.

items.name: Event Horizon
entries: The field becomes challenging to escape. A creature that attempts to leave the field by any means must make a Charisma saving throw or become {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the end of their turn, and the attempt fails. When a creature fails this saving throw, it takes {@damage 3d10} force damage.

items.name: Density
entries: The field becomes difficult terrain. When a creature moves within the area, it takes {@damage 2d10} force damage for every 5 feet it moves.

spell.name: Eclipse
entries: The air darkens around you. A 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} centred on you is filled with Dim Light as you absorb the light from the sky. You gain a flying speed of 60 feet, and become resistant to fire, cold, radiant and necrotic damage.

All creatures of your choice within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} must subtract your spellcasting ability modifier from any damage rolls they make. Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action}, you can target a creature within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} to draw power from them. That creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take {@damage 4d10} radiant or necrotic damage (your choice) and become {@condition Silenced|Starlight} until the start of your next turn, taking half as much damage only on a successful one. You gain temporary hit points equal to the amount of damage dealt.

spell.name: Cosmic Gradient
entries: You become the center of the Cosmic Gradient, creating a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that moves with you. When you cast the spell and at the start of each of your turns, you create up to three of the following effects in any combination, targeting creatures within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

{@b Redshift.} One creature must succeed a Wisdom saving throw or be thrown 30 feet away from you, become {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, and take {@damage 4d12} Force damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. If this movement collides with another creature, both fall {@condition Prone|XPHB}; if the other creature is more than one size larger than the target, it does not fall {@condition Prone|XPHB}.
{@b Blueshift.} You and one other creature gain the benefits of the {@spell Haste|XPHB} spell until the start of your next turn.

{@b Parallax.} Up to three creatures of your choice are teleported to any other location within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, choosing differently for each. The destination must be unoccupied and be able to support the creature teleported there. An unwilling creature can make a Charisma saving throw to resist the effect: on a success, it chooses another unoccupied within 5 feet of the destination you choose.
